decision_context.selection_rationale: Public CRUD and search endpoints require broad client interoperability with cache-aware HTTP semantics.
decision_context.naming_convention_summary: REST resources are plural lowercase nouns with hyphen-safe path segments and stable query key names.
decision_context.threshold_method_summary: Thresholds are derived from journey-level SLO budgets and adjusted by measured peak traffic and failure-domain risk.

threshold_policy.latency_target_derivation: Set p95 target from user-facing page SLA budget minus frontend and dependency budgets.
threshold_policy.availability_target_derivation: Set availability target using service criticality tier and error-budget policy.
threshold_policy.timeout_budget_derivation: Split timeout budget across client, edge, and service call graph depth.
threshold_policy.capacity_headroom_derivation: Reserve headroom from seasonal peak forecast and deployment surge margin.
threshold_policy.payload_limit_derivation: Set payload limits from mobile-network constraints and serializer CPU cost.
threshold_policy.concurrency_limit_derivation: Define limits using worker pool size and downstream saturation point.
threshold_policy.retry_backoff_derivation: Retry budget and backoff are derived from idempotency guarantees and dependency failure modes.
threshold_policy.delivery_semantics_derivation: Synchronous calls require deterministic request-response semantics with no duplicate side effects.
